final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor narrowed the claim to a policy-bounded, caveated position; no genuinely new admissible evidence was added. On the existing record, aggregate readiness passing by 2.1 percentage points and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support overall launch readiness, while the unresolved below-target aviation maintenance triage slice and incomplete draft runbook foreclose caveat-free certification. The internal policy and raw evidence support a narrower conclusion: certification is defensible only if launch materials explicitly disclose the unresolved limitation. That is enough for compliant_with_caveats as an audited position, but not enough for plain compliance, because the record still lacks evidence that the required disclosure has actually been made or that an approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists.
